components.name: Primary Action
components.css: .ds-action { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #7cff9e; border-radius: 2px; background: #7cff9e; color: #07100a; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: transform 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-action:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #a1ffb5; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cff9e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.description: Quiet navigation action beside the primary contact route.
components.css: .ds-action-secondary { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #424849; border-radius: 2px; background: #111516; color: #e7ece9; padding: 16px 24px; font-family: Bahnschrift, "Arial Narrow", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-action-secondary:hover { border-color: #7cff9e; background: #151a18; color: #7cff9e; } .ds-action-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cff9e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-email">EMAIL ADDRESS</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-email" type="email" placeholder="Enter your email">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 8px; color: #aeb7b2; font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; border: 1px solid #444b4b; border-radius: 2px; background: #0b0d0f; color: #f2f5f5; padding: 12px 16px; font: inherit; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #848f89; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #7cff9e; outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(124, 255, 158, 0.16); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; color: #c8cecb; font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; } .ds-nav-link { border-left: 1px solid #424849; color: inherit; padding: 0.72rem 1.05rem; font-size: 0.67rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:last-child { border-right: 1px solid #424849; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="location"] { background: #151a18; color: #7cff9e; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cff9e; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-service { border-right: 1px solid #424849; border-bottom: 1px solid #424849; background: #111516; padding: 24px; transition: background-color 180ms ease; } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-service { padding: 32px; } } .ds-service:hover, .ds-service:focus-within { background: #171d1a; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(124, 255, 158, 0.25); } .ds-service-meta { color: #7cff9e; font-family: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-service h3 { margin: 1rem 0 0.75rem; color: #edf2ef; font-family: Bahnschrift, "Arial Narrow", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.16rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-service p { color: #aeb7b2; font: 0.9rem/1.72 Bahnschrift, "Arial Narrow", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; }

components.css: .ds-instrument { border: 1px solid #424849; border-radius: 3px; background: #111516; color: #dfe5e1; padding: clamp(1rem, 2.4vw, 2rem); box-shadow: inset 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), 0 28px 64px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); } .ds-instrument-head, .ds-instrument-foot { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid #3b4242; padding-bottom: 14px; color: #9da8a1; font: 600 0.63rem/1.5 ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.13em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-instrument-foot { border-top: 1px solid #3b4242; border-bottom: 0; padding: 14px 0 0; } .ds-instrument-body { padding: 32px 0; color: #aeb7b2; font: 0.68rem/1.5 ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-align: center; } .ds-ready { color: #7cff9e; }

components.name: Route Dial
components.description: Focusable circular link indicating one of the three pathway destinations.
components.html: CONSULTING & INTEGRATION
components.css: .ds-route { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: #dfe5e1; text-align: center; text-decoration: none; } .ds-dial { display: grid; width: clamp(76px, 8vw, 112px); aspect-ratio: 1; place-items: center; border: 1px solid #707a75; border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #171c1a 0 45%, transparent 46%), repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, #b8c0bd 0 1deg, transparent 1deg 15deg); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px #151a18, inset 0 0 0 8px #414a45; transition: border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-needle { width: 2px; height: 38%; background: linear-gradient(to top, #5f6963 50%, #7cff9e 50%); transform: rotate(24deg); } .ds-route:hover, .ds-route:focus-visible { color: #7cff9e; } .ds-route:hover .ds-dial, .ds-route:focus-visible .ds-dial { border-color: #7cff9e; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 7px #151a18, inset 0 0 0 8px #7cff9e, 0 0 18px rgba(124, 255, 158, 0.13); } .ds-route:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #7cff9e; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-route-label { max-width: 14ch; font: 700 0.68rem/1.45 ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Consolas, monospace; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } @media (max-width: 767px) { .ds-dial { width: clamp(68px, 20vw, 92px); } }

narrative.overview:
Mavenix presents as a precise, low-light instrument panel: matte dark surfaces, restrained luminous markings, engraved-style labels, and fine rules. Its visual language helps visitors orient between business services, specialist recruitment, and retail interest without turning those routes into generic service cards or suggesting aviation capabilities.

The composition favors a direct proposition and contact action beside one distinctive instrument panel. Elsewhere, ruled grids, compact metadata, and understated surface changes keep information readable; green marks active or actionable states, while amber is reserved for the planned retail status.
keyCharacteristics: Panel black and charcoal establish the low-light field; luminous white and muted readouts carry content.
Radium green is the active signal; caution amber marks development status.
Platform system sans-serif carries prose, while platform monospace marks instrument and navigation labels.
Fine borders and square controls make the interface feel calibrated rather than ornamental.

rules.name: The State-Light Rule
rules.body: Green signals active or actionable content; amber is reserved for the in-development retail state.

rules.name: The Rule-Line Rule
rules.body: Use fine borders and ruled divisions to organize the dark surfaces before introducing extra surface colors or card-like elevation.

rules.name: The Instrument-Label Rule
rules.body: Reserve monospace, uppercase, tracked type for short labels and metadata; use the system sans for propositions and explanatory copy.

rules.name: The Flat-Plate Rule
rules.body: Let borders and surface tone carry the hierarchy; reserve shadows for distinct panels and floating interface elements.

dos: Do use the radium-green signal for active states, actionable links, focus, and primary actions.
Do use thin instrument-rule dividers to define section boundaries, navigation cells, and the service grid.
Do keep the three route dials labeled and linked to business services, recruitment, and retail.
Do preserve a visible keyboard-focus outline and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't turn the services into a generic stack of individually floating cards.
Don't use caution amber for ordinary actions or navigation; it marks the in-development state.
Don't add aviation claims, invented measurements, or decorative dashboard readouts.
Don't replace the squared controls and fine ruled geometry with pill buttons or heavily rounded cards.
